'''Wixx''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] member of the [[Balmorran resistance]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and Sith Empire. During the Republic liberation of [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] in [[3642 BBY]] she was commanding the [[Moraine Outpost]] in the [[Moraine Territory]]. She asked a Republic citizen to deal with the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Tharsis]] as well as several other threats to the outpost.
